# HelloBotz — Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API & Automation Platform

> HelloBotz is an enterprise-grade WhatsApp Business Solution and AI agent platform powered by the Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v20.0 with 99.99% uptime and zero-ban protection architecture.

## Organization & Headquarters
- **Name**: HelloBotz AI Technologies Pvt Ltd
- **Website**: https://hellobotz.com/
- **App Dashboard**: https://app.hellobotz.com/
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (560001)
- **Geographic Markets Served**: India, United Arab Emirates (UAE / Dubai / GCC), United States, United Kingdom, and Worldwide.
- **Support & Sales Email**: mail@hellobotz.com / support@hellobotz.com
- **Official Phone & WhatsApp**: +91 80508 54445

## Core Products & Capabilities
- **Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API v20.0**: High-throughput message infrastructure, 99.99% uptime SLA, automated template approval, zero-ban protection shield.
- **WhatsApp Green Tick Verification**: Direct assistance and end-to-end processing for the official Meta green verification badge.
- **Shared Team Inbox & Live Chat**: Centralized multi-agent customer support dashboard with automated routing, agent assignments, and conversation tagging.
- **Visual No-Code Flow Builder**: Drag-and-drop workflow automation for lead generation, qualification, appointment booking, and FAQs.
- **AI Agent & LLM Chatbots**: OpenAI GPT-powered conversational bots for contextual customer service and multilingual support.
- **Bulk WhatsApp Broadcasting**: Broadcast promotional messages, updates, and order notifications with contact segmentation and high-conversion delivery.
- **Click-to-WhatsApp Ads (CTWA)**: Automated lead capture and instant conversation initiation directly from Facebook & Instagram ads.
- **WhatsApp Native Payments**: In-chat payments via UPI, credit/debit cards, and payment gateway links with automated receipt generation.
- **B2B Business Leads Directory**: Targeted lead generation and industry-specific business contacts.
- **Partner & Reseller Ecosystem**: White-label WhatsApp API platform, agency programs, and affiliate partnerships.

## Platform Integrations
- E-Commerce: Shopify, WooCommerce, Shiprocket
- CRMs: Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce, Custom Webhooks
- Productivity: Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Zapier, Make.com, n8n
- Channels: WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, SMS, RCS
